reasoning: This question asks whether GOOG's closing price on March 22, 2026 will be higher than on March 15, 2026 - a 7-day period. Without access to real-time data or future information, I must rely on general market principles. Stock prices follow a random walk in efficient markets, meaning short-term price movements are essentially unpredictable. Over a 7-day period, there's no systematic reason to expect upward or downward movement. Historical data shows roughly equal probability of weekly gains versus losses for large-cap stocks like Google. Given the efficient market hypothesis and the short timeframe, the probability should be close to 50%.
